summary: Describes a hierarchical architecture of stateful PCEs, where a parent PCE coordinates child PCEs that each manage a part of the network. It sets out the requirements and procedures for computing traffic-engineered paths across multiple domains while keeping state.

eli5.summary: A big school has one head teacher who coordinates classroom teachers. Here a main route planner coordinates smaller planners for different parts of a network.

questions: how do stateful pces work across domains
